lq-deep.displayName: LQ Deep (only green used as text on light)

display.purpose: The episode title: hero headline. Archivo at 115% width, bold, uppercase, via the .display class. One per page.

h1.purpose: Section headlines and interior page titles, same .display voice one step down.

h2.purpose: Declared middle step reserved for denser interior pages; the shipped homepage jumps from h1 to h3.

h3.purpose: Prose subsection headings (semibold, sentence case), the confirmation-plate heading, and the SOLD badge size in the display voice.

body.purpose: All running copy, Newsreader 18px, max width ~36rem.

tag.purpose: Always paired with the .lower-third class: Archivo 110% width, semibold, uppercase, 0.06em tracking. Caption bars, nav, hours, labels, ticker, chips.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The only shadow: a soft warm-ink lift under raised controls and plates (green buttons, paper caption/confirmation plates). Never on sections, photos, or text.

motion.name: hero-settle
motion.purpose: The hero photo settles like a locked-off camera move, once on load. Class .hero-camera.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Hero headline, standfirst, buttons, and plate follow the settle, staggered at 150/300/450/500ms. Class .hero-rise.

motion.name: wipe-in
motion.purpose: Photos wipe in once like a segment cut at 0.35 viewport intersection; only elements below the viewport at mount ever hide. The clip lives on an inner wrapper because Chromium computes IntersectionObserver geometry after clip-path; never clip the observed element. Classes .wipe-hidden / .wipe-in.

motion.name: third-up
motion.purpose: The lower-third caption plate rises behind its photo's wipe. Classes .third-hidden / .third-up.

motion.name: sold-pop
motion.value: scale(1.6) rotate(4deg) -> scale(0.95) rotate(-3deg) at 70% -> scale(1) rotate(-3deg); 480ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both, 500ms delay
motion.purpose: The SOLD badge pops onto the photo after the wipe. Classes .sold-hidden / .sold-pop.

motion.name: ticker-scroll
motion.purpose: The broadcast ticker of store facts. Pauses on hover, focus-within, and the Stop/Play button; a mask fade (.ticker-fade) softens the exit edge. Class .ticker-track.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: animation: none on all six classes; hidden states forced visible; clip-path: none; SOLD keeps rotate(-3deg); global 0.01ms duration clamp
motion.purpose: The entire motion system collapses under prefers-reduced-motion with no content loss.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The green door. Green always carries ink text, never white; hover presses to lq-press, active nudges down 1px.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; background: var(--color-lq-green, #6BB22E); color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 115%; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; padding: 0 28px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(27 26 22 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgb(27 26 22 / 0.1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-lq-press, #588F24); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--color-lq-press, #588F24); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The second door: 2px ink border on the bright field, no shadow, hover fills cream.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 115%; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; padding: 0 28px; border: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-cream, #F1EBDF); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Board filter at rest: cream fill, ink lower-third label, no border. Hover fills sand.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; background: var(--color-cream, #F1EBDF); color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--color-sand, #E2D9C7); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip (Active)
components.description: The active filter goes green with ink text, marked by aria-pressed.
components.css: .ds-chip-active { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; background: var(--color-lq-green, #6BB22E); color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-active:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Phone field: sand hairline border, 6px radius, 48px tall, paper fill, ink text, stone placeholder, lq-press caret.
components.css: .ds-input { display: block; min-height: 48px; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; background: var(--color-paper, #FAF7F1); color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); caret-color: var(--color-lq-press, #588F24); font-family: Newsreader, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.125rem; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--color-sand, #E2D9C7); border-radius: 6px; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-stone, #6D675A); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Lower-Third Caption
components.description: The TV caption bar that labels every photo: green name plate plus a lifted paper category plate, pinned bottom-left.
components.css: .ds-third { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; } .ds-third-name { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-lq-green, #6BB22E); color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 12px; } .ds-third-cat { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-paper, #FAF7F1); color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.4; padding: 8px 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(27 26 22 / 0.06), 0 8px 24px rgb(27 26 22 / 0.1); }

components.name: SOLD Badge
components.description: The scarcity stamp: lq-deep display text on paper with a 3px lq-press border, resting at -3deg on a photo's top-right corner. Pops in with sold-pop; sold flags are placeholder data until synced with the real floor.
components.css: .ds-sold { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-paper, #FAF7F1); color: var(--color-lq-deep, #3E6B1A); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 115%; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.3; padding: 2px 12px; border: 3px solid var(--color-lq-press, #588F24); transform: rotate(-3deg); }

components.name: Ticker
components.description: Broadcast strip of store facts under the hero: cream band, sand borders, lower-third ink items separated by green dots, mask-faded edge, flush-right Stop/Play control.
components.html: Open Wed thru Sat 10 to 6, Sun 12 to 6589 N Coley Rd, TupeloLimited Quantities + Unlimited Savings
components.css: .ds-ticker { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--color-cream, #F1EBDF); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-sand, #E2D9C7); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-sand, #E2D9C7); padding-right: 64px; mask-image: linear-gradient(to right, transparent 0, #000 1.5rem, #000 calc(100% - 3.5rem), transparent 100%); } .ds-ticker-track { display: flex; width: max-content; animation: ds-ticker-scroll 36s linear infinite; } .ds-ticker:hover .ds-ticker-track, .ds-ticker:focus-within .ds-ticker-track { animation-play-state: paused; } .ds-ticker-item { display: flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); } .ds-ticker-dot { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; margin: 0 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-lq-green, #6BB22E); } .ds-ticker-stop { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; min-width: 48px; background: var(--color-cream, #F1EBDF); color: var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; font-stretch: 110%; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8125rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 0 12px; border: none; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-sand, #E2D9C7); cursor: pointer; } .ds-ticker-stop:hover { background: var(--color-sand, #E2D9C7); } .ds-ticker-stop:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-ink, #1B1A16); outline-offset: 2px; } @keyframes ds-ticker-scroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

narrative.overview: The site is the furniture makeover show, playing on a bright set. This world replaced an earlier dark ink-field rendition that the client rejected after seeing it built; nothing from that world survives here. A warm paper field carries big square photographs of the real warehouse floor in Tupelo, and the whole system exists to make that photography glow: cream and sand do the quiet structural work, warm ink talks, and one working green marks where something happens. Photos are labeled the way television labels people, with lower-third caption bars, and scarcity is stamped on with a SOLD badge because the scarcity is real. Type carries the show's two registers: Archivo set a touch wide (115% width, bold, uppercase) is the episode title, and the same face at 110% semibold caps is the lower-third caption voice; Newsreader talks like a person from North Mississippi in between. Motion is the reveal grammar in five authored moments and nothing else: the hero settles like a locked-off camera move, photos wipe in once like a segment cut, lower-thirds rise behind them, the SOLD badge pops, and a broadcast ticker runs store facts under the hero until the visitor hits Stop. Everything collapses under prefers-reduced-motion with the content left visible.
keyCharacteristics: Bright warm paper field (#FAF7F1) everywhere; the dark world is dead and must not return
One working green as the action color; green surfaces always carry ink text, and only lq-deep may appear as green text on the light field
Two type voices from one show: Archivo wide shouting episode titles and captioning photos, Newsreader talking
Square full-bleed floor photography labeled by lower-third caption bars, never boxed in cards
Depth is one soft lift shadow on raised controls only; everything else separates with 1px sand hairlines
Five authored motion moments in reveal grammar, all reduced-motion safe

rules.name: The Ink-on-Green Rule
rules.body: Green surfaces always take ink text (6.8:1). White on green measures 2.6:1 and is never used.

rules.name: The Deep Green Text Rule
rules.body: On the light field, the only green that may be text is lq-deep. Bright lq-green as text on paper measures 2.4:1 and never ships; when a green accent must read, it reads in lq-deep.

rules.name: The Lit Set Rule
rules.body: The field stays bright and warm so the floor photography does the selling. No dark sections, no dark theme, no washes or gradients over photos; the client rejected the dark rendition after seeing it built.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Uppercase happens only in the two Archivo voices: .display shouts, .lower-third captions. Newsreader is always sentence case and never uppercase, bold, or letter-spaced.

rules.name: The Caption Bar Rule
rules.body: A photo is labeled by a .lower-third plate sitting on its bottom-left edge, in the tag size, never by a caption below it or text over an unplated image.

rules.name: The Raised Control Rule
rules.body: shadow-lift appears only on something a visitor can press or on a paper plate sitting over a photo or a cream band. Sections, photos, tables, and text never cast shadows.

rules.name: The Inner Wrapper Rule
rules.body: Chromium computes IntersectionObserver geometry after clip-path, so a fully clipped observed element never intersects. Wipes therefore always clip an inner wrapper while the observed outer element stays unclipped. Never put wipe-hidden on the element the observer watches.

rules.name: The Five Moments Rule
rules.body: New motion must be one of the five moments or speak the reveal grammar (settles, wipes, lower-thirds, badge pops, tickers). Generic fade-up-on-scroll on every section, parallax, and hover zooms are outside the world.

rules.name: The Reduced Motion Rule
rules.body: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, every animation class is set to animation: none, hidden states resolve to fully visible, wipe clips resolve to clip-path: none, the SOLD badge keeps its resting -3deg, and a global rule zeroes all remaining animation and transition durations. Content is never lost when motion is off.

dos: Do keep the TCPA/SMS consent language verbatim from src/lib/consent.ts (SMS_CONSENT_TEXT, versioned as SMS_CONSENT_VERSION). It is regulated content, not marketing copy: never shortened, reworded, or restructured for conversion, always beside an unchecked checkbox, with the version bumped on any legally reviewed change.
Do give every interactive element a 48px minimum tap target (min-h-12 / min-w-12), even inline footer links, and rely on the global 2px ink focus ring.

Do run photography square, full bleed, and real: shot on the LQ floor (IMG_8587-8637 set, 2200px wide, 4:3, object-cover), never stock, never AI, never boxed in a padded card, always labeled by a lower-third.

Do write copy in the store's voice: plain, warm, direct, sentence case, their words not ours (the tagline is Limited Quantities + Unlimited Savings). No em dashes. No marketing filler (elevate, curated, seamless, transform, unlock, discover). Buttons say what happens. Urgency must be factually true.
Do end every page at one of the two doors: join the text list or financing. The store is the store; the site sells the visit.
Do keep pages light: no animation, UI, icon, or state libraries; rural 4G is the baseline (LCP < 2.0s, CLS < 0.05, first-load JS < 120KB gzipped).
donts: Don't put lq-green text on the light field (2.4:1) or white text on green (2.6:1); green text on light is always lq-deep, and green surfaces always take ink.
Don't reintroduce anything from the dead dark world: no ink page fields, no dark sections, no DM Mono.
Don't add gradients, glows, glassmorphism, blur, icons, emoji, carousels, numbered marker sequences, icon feature grids, or fabricated testimonials. All are confirmed client rejections.
Don't round anything past 6px, round structural corners at all, or put shadow-lift on non-raised surfaces.
Don't imply anything can be bought online, show prices, or fake scarcity; sold flags come from the real floor, not from copywriting.
Don't ship motion outside the five moments, clip an IntersectionObserver target directly, or let any animation survive prefers-reduced-motion.
